description_zh: 调用DescribeDiagnosticReportList接口，查询诊断报告
name: DescribeDiagnosticReportList

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大记录数，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
查询任务结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
查询任务结束时间需晚于查询任务开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

Data.description_en:
The information of the diagnostics reports. Valid values:

total: the number of diagnostics reports.

score: the health score.

diagnosticTime: the time when the diagnostics report was generated. The time is displayed in UTC.

startTime: the start time of the query. The time is displayed in UTC.

endTime: the end time of the query. The time is displayed in UTC
Data.description_zh:
返回的数据：

total：数据量。
score：诊断分数。
diagnosticTime：诊断生成时间（UTC 时间）。
startTime：查询开始时间（UTC 时间）。
endTime：查询结束时间（UTC 时间）

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
